icons.name: Ascending-Bar E
icons.concept: Red-spine letter E with white arms of ascending length (E + rising ELO chart) and a gold breakthrough peak stepping above the top bar, on Void.

icons.name: ER Monogram Tile
icons.concept: Heavy white ER monogram (bold condensed E plus an R with proper bowl, counter, and diagonal leg) seated on a Void plate inside a full-bleed Signal Red tile.

icons.name: Staircase E Lettermark
icons.concept: Abstract modern E rendered as a solid Signal Red stem with three cantilevered arms of ascending length, white tip-caps marking each arm, and a gold breakthrough cap rising above the longest arm.

icons.name: Tied Knot
icons.concept: Head-on tied gi belt knot crossing a dark belt band, with a four-stripe rank bar and a red rank-tipped hanging tail.

icons.name: Rank Meter Belt
icons.concept: Horizontal belt band whose black rank-tab stripes fill left-to-right as a red-to-gold ELO progress meter, climbing to a gold breakthrough stripe.

icons.name: Diagonal Rank Mark
icons.concept: Abstract modern belt: a heavy black band sweeps diagonally across a deep-red ground with an inset rank tab of three white stripes and one red, edged in Signal Red.

icons.name: Tatami Arena
icons.concept: Top-down brutalist competition mat: tatami tile grid framing a central Signal Red contest zone with a referee cross and engagement dot.

icons.name: Closed Guard
icons.concept: Abstract closed-guard position glyph: red legs wrap and lock with a crossed-ankle X over a controlled white torso gripped by two bars.

icons.name: Two Zones
icons.concept: Matchmaking mark: the arena circle split into red and white zones interlocking on a bold dovetail seam, one athlete dot per side.

icons.name: Breakthrough Trend
icons.concept: Ascending bar chart with a heavy Signal Red trend arrow surging over a gold breakthrough bar to an up-arrowhead peak.

icons.name: Podium Climb
icons.concept: Ascending staircase podium on brand red with a highlighted white top tier carved with an upward arrow.

icons.name: ELO Ascent Lettermark
icons.concept: Bold geometric ELO lettermark whose letters rise in height, the tallest O a red ring capped with a gold peak.

icons.name: Triangle Lock
icons.concept: Two interlocking triangles (triangle choke / closed guard) woven over-under with a locked red center node.

icons.name: Lapel Grip
icons.concept: A heavy white fist with four knuckles and a wrapping thumb clamping a bold diagonal Signal Red gi lapel.

icons.name: Matched Clinch
icons.concept: Two mirror-symmetric figures (white vs void) clinched and bound by a red seam into one balanced, evenly-weighted mark.

icons.name: The Cut
icons.concept: A bold diagonal slash divides the tile into void and Signal Red, with a brutalist E (gold breakthrough peak) carved in the dark half and a mirrored void glyph in the red half.

icons.name: Planted Monolith
icons.concept: A single heavy black slab driven into a deep-red ground, capped in gold with a Signal Red flag blade flying off it and a white impact band at the strike point.

icons.name: Impact Nest
icons.concept: Concentric squares collapsing toward a white core with gold and Signal Red collision wedges driving in from opposing corners: two athletes meeting at the center.
